description: Call this when a product we said would work didn't (within 60 days of the check): send the receipt_id and what happened. Decided within 10 business days; if our answer or data was wrong, the fee paid for that check is refunded and the data corrected. Free. For a plain fit/no-fit report without a claim, use report_outcome.

evidence_url.description: Optional link to a photo, the order or a manufacturer page showing the problem.

receipt_id.description: The receipt id (rcpt_...) of the check that was wrong.

what_happened.description: What was bought, what it was used with, and what didn't work.

name: file_claim
title: Report a wrong answer (claim)
